name: Eloqua API Redux
description: Integrate Drupal 8+ modules with the Oracle Eloqua REST API.
project_description:
This module allows integration between Drupal 8+ and Eloqua REST API. 

 Oracle Eloqua's Application API is a RESTful API which is used to extend the functionality of Eloqua's automation engines, Program Builder and Campaign Canvas, and to build applications for Eloqua's AppCloud.

 Back to top 

 Services Provided 
 Currently we provide the core services needed for Webforms Integration via https://www.drupal.org/project/webform_eloqua module. 

 

 Back to top 

 Additional API Services: 
 If you need additional API resources, please open a ticket and collaborate.

 Back to top 

 Requirements: 
 
 Eloqua subscription - If you do not already have a Eloqua Subscription, or are not considering getting one, this module will not do anything for you. 
 You are not required to be a developer to use this module. Other modules such as Webform Eloqua will do the hard integration work so you dont have to. 
 
 Back to top 

 Development Status 
 The module has gone through some limited manual testing, but needs automated tests. It is highly advised that you carry out your own usage testing prior to use in Production Environment.
